header_sentences: See Internal Church, and see Jacob.

contexts.text: As the man Japheth, or the man of the external Church, does not know these things...
The Lord's complaint concerning the Church, that it is only external. Treated of.

The steward of my house = the external Church... The external Church is no other; for all stewardship belongs to the external of the Church; as the administration of rituals... The external things of the Church, without the internal, are of no account... Nevertheless, the externals of the Church are like the externals of man...
These things represented... things of the Spiritual Church, and also those of the external Church.
Edom = those who are in simple good, which is such good as exists with those who constitute the Lord's external Church.
Appearances of a still lower degree... in which may be the men who are of the external Church. Treated of.
He said to him who was over his house = that which is of the external Church.
He binds his donkey's colt to the vine = truth in the Natural for the external Church.
For they who belong to the external Church cannot elevate their thought higher than to the Lord's Divine Natural.
The truth which is a matter of knowledge, which is here represented by Moses, is the truth of the external Church.

The men of the external Church, who are represented by the Hebrew servants, are they who learn truth from no delight, but only because it is the truth of the Church through which they believe they can be saved... In the other life such are at the entrance to Heaven, because they correspond to the skin.
Delight is instead of good in the man of the external Church.

Spiritual good... cannot be conjoined with those who are in the externals of the Church... for they who are in the externals of the Church cannot be affected by the truths of faith otherwise than principally for the sake of themselves... Signified. AC 8981:2, Explained.
The vastation of the external Church also. Signified. The land = the external Church.
Under External, see this reference. AC 10547. AC 10571, etc.

By those who are in an external in which there is an internal, who are those who are called the men of the external Church (this light from the interiors of the Word) is not perceived; but still it is present, and affects them.
